_help: Game Developer track. Self-contained: 'id', 'label', 'icon' (Font Awesome name) and 'order' control the tab button. 'badges' (OPTIONAL): logo buttons under the role; each is {logo, label, url} OR {icon (Font Awesome classes, e.g. 'fa-brands fa-github'), label, url}. 'icon' also auto-fills if the logo image fails. If 'url' is omitted the badge is not a link. Every project's 'media' is OPTIONAL and can be a single object or an array. Media types: 'image', 'gif' (both render as ), 'video' (autoplay loop muted), 'loom' (iframe embed). Empty/missing src or no 'media' = text-only project.
